messages.subject: The Vault Birmingham - defects at the new club
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We have a serious problem at the Vault Birmingham club we picked up through the Brampton acquisition. Since opening in March the pool has had to close three times on environmental health directions, there is water coming through the pool hall roof, and the air conditioning in the studios can't cope. Membership is falling and Charles is understandably worried.

The main contractor was Hartwell Construction under a JCT design and build contract. Can Whitfield Carter advise on recovering our losses from them? Happy to send over the contract and the issues log.

Nathan

Nathan Reilly
Head of M&A | Kingsford Group Limited

messages.subject: RE: The Vault Birmingham - defects at the new club
messages.plaintextBody:
Nathan,

Yes, we can certainly help - this is squarely the kind of construction defects claim our team handles. I'm bringing in Tom Gallagher, who leads on our TCC work, and Elena Marchetti.

As a first step we should get an independent building services and facade engineer to investigate and report, so that any claim is properly evidenced before we write to Hartwell. We'll also need the building contract, the Employer's Requirements, the practical completion certificate and the environmental health correspondence.

I'll send a short engagement note today. Let's get the investigation moving quickly given the pool closures.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 20 7946 0102
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
